2. The relevant facts, for the disposal of this appeal, are that the appellant instituted the aforesaid suit for declaration that the kabala deed No. 15607 dated 17-10-1994 executed by Nazera Bibi, plaintiff No. 1 in favour of defendant No. 1 Abdul Mazid was forged, fraudulent, inoperative and the same was not binding upon the plaintiff stating, inter alia, that the scheduled land belonged to the defendant No. 1 who sold 0.66 acre of land to his second wife, the plaintiff No. 1, in lieu of dower money by registered deed No. 4925 dated 14-12-1992. The defendant No. 1 also sold 0.10 acre of land of the suit plot to the plaintiff No. 1 by another registered deed No. 4104 dated 31-10-1993 and handed over possession of those lands. Thus, the plaintiff No. 1 became the owner of 0.76 acre of land described in schedule to the plaint. Owing to extreme misbehaviour of the first wife of the defendant No. 1 with the plaintiff No. 1 she went to her father's house and, thereafter, gave birth to a son. The plaintiff No. I filed Mutation Case No. 242/18-1/95-96 for mutation of that 0.76 acre of land in her name. The defendant No. 1 raised objection in that mutation case stating that the plaintiff No. 1, after getting entire dower money, returned the said 0.76 acre of land to the defendant No. 1 by executing and registering sale deed being No. 15607 dated 17-10-1994 (the impugned deed). However, she got her name mutated in the khatian. Thereafter, she procured the certified copy of impugned sale deed No. 15607 dated 17-10-1994 and confirmed about the forged deed. She never executed any such sale deed in favour of the defendant No. 1, who forged the same beyond her knowledge in another Sub-Registrar's office within the jurisdiction of which the plaintiff No. 1 had no property at all. The further case of the plaintiffs was that being in need of money the plaintiff No. 1 sold 0.53 acre of land out of the suit land to the plaintiff No. 2 by two registered sale deeds dated 30-5-1995 and 7-7-1996 and handed over possession of the same. They have been possessing the entire 0.76 acre of land. The plaintiff No. 1 never executed the impugned deed and the defendant No. 1 had created the same by false personation. 

 8. It appears from the pleadings that the impugned deed was executed and registered on 17-10-1994 in respect of the land measuring an area of 0.76 acre of RS Khatian No. 160 and Plot No. 86 of Mouza Mohor, Police Station-Tanore, District-Rajshahi. It is evident that the said deed was executed in the Sub-Registrar's office of Nababgonj inasmuch as the suit land is situated within the jurisdiction of Tanore SR Office, Rajshahi.
